### Jesus Overcomes Satan
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jesus-overcomes-satan
Passage: Matthew 4:8-11
Points:
- Satan offered Jesus immediate rule over worldly kingdoms in exchange for worship.
- The temptation sought to entice Christ to bypass the suffering of the cross.
- Unlike Adam and the nation of Israel, Jesus refused to pursue godless autonomy or idolatry.
- Jesus banished the devil by standing firmly on the biblical command to worship God alone.
- Having experienced and conquered temptation, Christ provides strength for believers to resist sin.

### Bible Pathways 10/02/04
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-10-or-02-or-04-1287913.html
Passage: Matthew 4:1-10
Points:
- Satan first targeted Jesus' physical hunger, urging Him to satisfy legitimate needs through self-serving means.
- The enemy twisted Scripture at the temple pinnacle to tempt Jesus into presumptuous pride.
- The final trial offered all worldly power without the cross in return for worshipping the devil.
- Allowing even a single compromise opens the door to further spiritual defeat.
- Believers reveal their true character and overcome spiritual attack through submission to God's Word.
